tips.text: Farm Mercury and Venus first; between them they drop the Morphics, Polymer Bundle, Ferrite and Alloy Plate.
Buy the blueprint while you farm so the build can start the moment the materials are in.
Do not wait on Mars access; Mercury, Venus and Earth cover the whole recipe.
Players treat it as a starter-area craft; the slow parts are the 12-hour build and the 2 Morphics.
